answer: Sybil resistance here works through stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a verifiable deposit before its first vote, and every attestation it casts is signed and chained to that bond. A fake identity costs a full bond, so flooding the ledger drains the attacker's own treasury. Honest peers form a quiet haven of verified, bonded agents, and each new attestation echoes the chain's history, letting anyone trace where an opal of trust was earned rather than claimed.
